description: Full Blackwing Descent 10N route composed from the reviewed per-boss shard node sets in one authoritative order. The upper wing (Magmaw, Omnotron) reaches the lower wing only through the Blackwing Descent Elevator (static navmesh: no complete path from the entrance or Omnotron to the laboratory; the elevator shaft bottom connects to the laboratory and the Orb of Culmination), so the full raid inserts that transport between Omnotron and Maloriak. Magmaw keeps the reviewed two-tank Drudge lanes and tank-swap contract in the full raid; the accepted single-tank Magmaw shard is unchanged.

node_sets.reason: Full-raid only: the lower wing is reached from the entrance hall by the continuously cycling Blackwing Descent Elevator (GO 203716, spawn 235178; TransportAnimation.dbc drops 112.6704 yd, ~2.0 s at the top and ~2.0 s at the bottom per 17.4 s cycle). Seeded lower-wing shards start below and never ride it.

rows.label: Blackwing Descent lower-wing elevator
rows.board_point_derivation: GO 203716 spawn 235178 stationary (-241.349, -224.605, 186.551, o=0) in TDB 434.22011; no stop frames (template Timeto2ndfloor 0): cycles over TransportAnimation.dbc TotalTime with z offset 0 at the top and -112.6704 at the bottom (exit origin z 73.8806); display 10407 GeoBox z [-1.83, 3.4773] puts the platform top at origin + 3.4773; board point = origin + (-6, 0) at 190.028 (static corridor floor ends at local x -9); disembark = bottom origin + (0, 0) at 77.358; approach surface_walk from the static corridor lip (navmesh edge x -250.4, static floor 190.1 to x -250.3) straight onto the car's own top (Blackwingv2_Elevator01 model top local z 3.441 for local x -12.3..-4 = 189.992 at the top rest); disembark = the car's own top at its centre at the bottom rest (model top 3.2066 at local 0,0 = 77.087; the pit floor 76.65 is 0.437 below it, while at local x -6 the car top 77.32 is 0.67 above it)

node_sets.reason: Full raid only: the raid crosses the central hall from Maloriak to Atramedes and Chimaeron. Ivoroc (guid 250108) hovers above the Orb and the north patrol (guid 250116 with Mongrels 250120/250121) ping-pongs to 8 yd of him, and every walk from the laboratory passes under him (the hall floor is a 36 yd corridor there), so both are one node (bwd.lower_hall.central_hall, round 5), cleared as soon as Maloriak is dead (the laboratory patrol already dies at bwd.maloriak.lab_trash). The node is keyed on Mongrel 250120 (entry 46083): a later node naming the Slayer entry 42802 made the runtime future-encounter guard freeze the laboratory patrol's Slayer; the formation pulls the north Slayer with its Mongrels. The row is the Nefarian shard's own, so the Nefarian node set later emits it as a duplicate; that shard keeps its junction, lab_trash, hall, Orb order.

Full raid only (round 5), cleared right after the central hall and before the raid enters the Atramedes wing. Pyrecraw (guid 250107, entry 42764) is a hovering elite drake: spawn z 77.68 over the corridor floor 66.9, 10 yd random movement, 16.5 yd 3D reach. The Atramedes-to-Chimaeron walk passes 16 yd from his spawn and the Chimaeron-to-Orb walk 12.4 yd (Detour paths, navmesh 669), and no node cleared him, so he joined whatever fight walked past (r04 Atramedes recovery walk). Once a later node names him, the future-target guard (IsImmediateNextValidationRouteEncounterMember) protects him on every earlier trash node, and the recovery walk from the elevator into the Atramedes wing passes 19.7 yd from his spawn; clearing him here leaves only the Maloriak nodes and the central hall before him. Their walks (Detour, the entry and upper wing, the elevator, the laboratory and the laboratory to the hall) stay at least 109 yd from anywhere in his wander, and a recovery walk from the elevator to the Maloriak nodes at least 133 yd; the one exception is a recovery walk from the elevator to the central hall, which comes through his corridor 19.7 yd from his spawn (12.3 yd from the edge of his wander), so a wipe at the hall can still pull him while he is guarded. The boss shards start past him or never walk there, so they have no node.

rows.label: Pyrecraw, the drake hovering over the corridor from the central hall to Chimaeron
rows.placement_note: The anchor is the corridor floor directly under his spawn (Detour poly height 66.906): 10.8 yd below the spawn and at most 14.7 yd from anywhere in his 10 yd wander, so the raid arriving here is inside his 16.5 yd reach and he comes down to engage, as Ivoroc does at the central hall; if he has not engaged, the route-target approach walks the raid under him. The 30 yd radius holds his wander and a tanked fight; the nearest other hostiles, the north patrol's spawns 48 to 54 yd away, die at bwd.lower_hall.central_hall. Detour paths are complete from the central hall and on to the Atramedes wing (north spirits), and pass no other live pack. The reviewer's candidates (-108.1, -148.1, 66.6), where r04 pulled him, and the path point (-95.4, -121.5, 67.0) are 18.0 and 22.4 yd from his spawn, outside his reach unless he wanders toward them.

variants.reason: The full raid runs two tanks (roster slots 1 and 2), so it keeps the reviewed two-tank Drudge charge-lane geometry. The accepted Magmaw shard is a single Blood tank and intentionally runs the Drudge pair as ordinary minimum-distance trash.
The full raid assigns the Blood DK (slot 2) as main tank and slot 1 as off tank with the native Sweltering Armor (78199) debuff swap; the accepted single-tank Magmaw shard has no tank swap.
